newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Pac sells Island Dyeing stake.
newsitem.headline: First Pac sells Island Dyeing stake.

text.p: First Pacific Co Ltd said on Thursday it had agreed to sell its entire 29.8 percent stake in Island Dyeing and Printing Co Ltd to four independent parties for HK$292 million.

First Pacific said in a statement the transaction, at a price of HK$14.80 per share for about 19.7 million shares, represented a premium of 6.5 percent above Island Dyeing's closing price of HK$13.90 on Thursday.
The four buyers were Castle Baynard Holdings Ltd, Welmax Ltd, Ocean-Reef Co Holdings Corp and Wellard Enterprises Holdings Ltd, it said.

Island Dyeing, which discontinued its dyeing and printing operations in 1995, is a property investment company whose main asset is a parcel of property in the Kwai Chung district of west Kowloon that has been designated for redevelopment as a hotel, residential and commercial facility.
Island Dyeing posted a loss of HK$12 million for the year ended March 31, 1996, and a loss of HK$11.61 million the year before.
